title: constants_block
description: Spec IV shared building block, always present on result-bearing responses. Values shown are the spec values and are not frozen as constants, so a corrected constant is not a contract break. The source map is written as {...} in the issue, so it stays open.

GM.description: Earth gravitational parameter in m^3/s^2. Spec value 3.986004418e14.

R_e.description: Earth equatorial radius in m. Spec value 6378137.0.

omega_sid_rad_s.description: Sidereal rotation rate in rad/s. Spec value 7.292115e-5.

citation_id.description: Run identifier of the form run_YYYYMMDD_..., resolvable through GET /v1/citation.

source.description: Source document per constant, as required by spec II.10 provenance.
